title: VIBANN inverse design yields bulk metallic glasses above 2200 HV
summary: VIBANN, a variational information bottleneck with attention-based neural networks, generated new multicomponent metallic glass compositions. Five inverse-designed B-Co-Fe-Re-W-(Ni/Cr/V) glasses were synthesized as bulk amorphous alloys with Vickers hardness above 2200 HV. The abstract does not state how many designs were attempted or the hit rate, and the 'record-level' claim was not checked; this is a version 1 preprint.
ai_technology: Variational information bottleneck with attention-based neural networks, Monte Carlo dropout and Gaussian mixture latent-space optimization generating alloy compositions

evidence.tested: Experimental synthesis and hardness testing of five predicted compositions.
evidence.unknown: Number of designs attempted, comparison with the best known glasses and reproducibility; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Proposes alloy compositions through latent-space optimization that are then made and tested.

source_review.scope: Version 1 abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations not retrieved. Full text not accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
